_comment: edgerun's public blocklist. Every entry is a claim anyone can check: the evidence field says what was measured and how, and the commit history of this file says who added it and when. Nothing goes in here on a hunch — an entry needs a reproducible observation (a reverted transfer simulation, a registry mismatch, an on-chain fact), not a report. To add one, open a pull request against frontend/public/blocklist.json with the evidence filled in.

entries.name: memestock
entries.evidence: eth_call transfer(0x…dEaD, 1) simulated from each of the 3 top holders with a live non-zero balance: all three reverted "blacklisted". Balances were read on chain immediately before simulating, so this is not a stale-balance artefact.
entries.also: Uses the ticker TSLA, which Robinhood publishes at 0x322f0929c4625ed5bad873c95208d54e1c003b2d.

entries.name: Tesla • Robinhood Token
entries.reason: copies the official name exactly, and blocks some holders but not others
entries.evidence: Name is byte-for-byte the official "Tesla • Robinhood Token" while the address is not in Robinhood's registry. Transfer simulation succeeded for 2 of 3 live holders and reverted "blacklisted" for the third — a targeted restriction rather than a global one.
